exposure: Antenatal Strategies (aggressive management of genitourinary infections, increased antenatal care visits with targeted counseling on danger signs, and promotion of maternal exercises)
cohort: The study cohort included 3,527 deliveries (all deliveries ≥24 weeks' gestation) at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Targeted intrapartum and antenatal interventions, guided by Robson Classification analysis, significantly reduced the overall Cesarean section rate from 45.42% to 37.54% (p < 0.05).
mod_finding: An increase in the vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rate was observed in Robson Group 5 (women with previous CS, single cephalic, term pregnancies) post-intervention.
